name: All Solar
old_description: Proudly based in Wyoming. Let us help you harness the power of the sun.
about:
All Solar operates from Casper, Wyoming, where it has served the region for over 15 years. The company was established to provide solar energy solutions across the state, though the exact founding year and founders are not publicly disclosed.

The firm designs and installs solar arrays for commercial, residential, and off-grid applications, including battery storage and backup systems for remote properties. Its service portfolio also covers ongoing maintenance, cleaning, and real-time system monitoring through a proprietary mobile app. No facility size or headcount figures are published.

Customers range from offices, warehouses, and agricultural operations seeking to reduce operating costs, to homeowners aiming to lower utility bills, and ranch or cabin owners requiring reliable off-grid power. The company references installations for industrial and agricultural facilities as well as custom residential systems built for Wyoming's climate.

All Solar emphasizes expertise, transparency, and customer care as differentiators, backing installations with comprehensive warranties, long-term maintenance, and flexible financing options that include no-debt structures. The company states its Wyoming-built commercial systems are tailored to each facility's energy goals.
